# gns3_link (Resource)

A link between two node ports in a GNS3 project. Any change to either `node` block replaces the link.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gns3_project" "lab" {
  name = "tf-example-link"
}

data "gns3_template" "vpcs" {
  name = "VPCS"
}

resource "gns3_node" "pc1" {
  project_id      = gns3_project.lab.project_id
  template_id     = data.gns3_template.vpcs.template_id
  name            = "PC1"
  x               = -150
  start_on_create = true
}

resource "gns3_node" "pc2" {
  project_id      = gns3_project.lab.project_id
  template_id     = data.gns3_template.vpcs.template_id
  name            = "PC2"
  x               = 150
  start_on_create = true
}

# Ports come back from the server after the nodes are created.
resource "gns3_link" "pc1_pc2" {
  project_id = gns3_project.lab.project_id

  node {
    node_id        = gns3_node.pc1.node_id
    adapter_number = gns3_node.pc1.ports[0].adapter_number
    port_number    = gns3_node.pc1.ports[0].port_number
  }

  node {
    node_id        = gns3_node.pc2.node_id
    adapter_number = gns3_node.pc2.ports[0].adapter_number
    port_number    = gns3_node.pc2.ports[0].port_number
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project UUID. Changing it replaces the link.

### Optional

- `filters` (String) Packet filters as a JSON object (use `jsonencode`), for example `jsonencode({ frequency_drop = [50], delay = [100, 10] })`. Removing it clears the filters.
- `node` (Block List) One end of the link. Exactly two blocks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--node))
- `suspend` (Boolean) Suspend the link (no traffic passes). Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `link_id` (String) Link UUID assigned by the server.
- `link_type` (String) `ethernet` or `serial`, set by the server from the ports.

<a id="nestedblock--node"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node`

Required:

- `adapter_number` (Number) Adapter number, for example `gns3_node.pc1.ports[0].adapter_number`.
- `node_id` (String) Node UUID, for example `gns3_node.pc1.node_id`.
- `port_number` (Number) Port number on the adapter, for example `gns3_node.pc1.ports[0].port_number`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <project_id>/<link_id>.
terraform import gns3_link.pc1_pc2 1740ba78-ed59-4da9-880d-d2f4675a06c2/39a5ec94-aa23-4825-baad-853f0ac63e4a
```
